title: React Fundamentals
description: Test components, JSX, props, state, keys, and event handling in React.

questions.optionB: A syntax extension used to describe React UI
questions.solution: JSX is a JavaScript syntax extension that describes the UI React should render.

questions.questionText: How should a component treat its props?
questions.solution: Props are input supplied by a parent and should not be mutated by the receiving component.

questions.questionText: Why does React need a key for items rendered from an array?
questions.optionB: To identify items consistently between renders
questions.solution: A stable key helps React match each item with its previous rendered counterpart.

questions.questionText: Which prop is used for a browser click event?
questions.solution: React uses the camel-cased onClick prop for click event handlers.

questions.questionText: What usually happens after a component state update?
questions.optionA: React schedules a render with the new state
questions.solution: Updating state schedules React to render the affected component with its latest state.
